primary.title: Gold vs Nifty 50: What would ₹1 lakh invested 20 years ago be worth today? Check post-tax returns
primary.summary: Gold has outperformed the Nifty 50 over the past 20 years, but returns are only part of the comparison. Their capital gains tax treatment is different too. Here’s what ₹1 lakh invested 20 years ago could be worth today and how much an investor may keep after tax.
